headline: Real control-cell resampling — VCC 2026 validation, 360k cells, 300 targets
hypotheses_preregistered: Sampling real control cells will improve on the sparse baseline by preserving single-cell dispersion
Perturbation discrimination will still be near zero because every target shares the same control pool
log: Swapped the sparse slice for real single-cell resampling — 360k control cells with natural dispersion. Score jumped to -0.304: dispersion matters, but the targets were still indistinguishable.
